scope: Real native Mono 6.8/SGen x86-64 metadata, JIT addresses, field layout, pinned-object reads/writes, resident refresh, long names, concurrent requests, late assemblies, actual GC, CLI/Lua and normal shutdown on host, PID/mount namespace and ASan/UBSan engine. Production agent installed and AppImage bundling updated. Native Mono/Wine classification separated. Required native/sanitizer/release gates added.
